description: This file defines logic for resolving the effective connection mode in an application, based on configuration data, remote URL, user defaults, and onboarding status. It includes enums, a struct, and a resolver for determining the current connection mode with its source.

classes.name: EffectiveConnectionMode
classes.description: A struct combining the connection mode with its source to indicate how the mode was determined.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: A static method that determines the current effective connection mode based on provided configuration, remote URL, stored user defaults, and onboarding status.
